extracted_concepts.name: Natürliche Zahlen
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Positive integers starting from 1 used for counting and ordering.

extracted_concepts.name: Stellenwertsystem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Number representation system where digit value depends on its position relative to powers of ten.

extracted_concepts.name: Grundrechenarten
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Fundamental mathematical operations: addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.

extracted_concepts.name: Brüche
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Numbers representing parts of a whole, expressed as a numerator divided by a denominator.

extracted_concepts.name: Dezimalzahlen
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Numbers expressed using a decimal point to separate the integer part from the fractional part.

extracted_concepts.name: Prozentrechnung
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Mathematical method for expressing a number as a fraction of one hundred.

extracted_concepts.name: Flächenfiguren
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Two-dimensional geometric shapes bounded by straight or curved lines.

extracted_concepts.name: Symmetrie
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Geometric property where a figure remains invariant under reflection or rotation transformations.

extracted_concepts.name: Raumkörper
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Three-dimensional geometric objects occupying space, such as cubes, cylinders, and spheres.

extracted_concepts.name: Längenmaße
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Standard units for measuring distance including millimeters, centimeters, meters, and kilometers.

extracted_concepts.name: Gewichtsmaße
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Standard units for measuring mass including grams and kilograms.

extracted_concepts.name: Zeitmaße
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Standard units for measuring duration including seconds, minutes, hours, and days.

extracted_concepts.name: Hohlmaße
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Standard units for measuring liquid volume including milliliters and liters.

extracted_concepts.name: Balkendiagramm
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Data visualization tool using rectangular bars with lengths proportional to the values they represent.

extracted_concepts.name: Mittelwert
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Arithmetic average calculated by summing all data points and dividing by the total count.

extracted_concepts.name: Wahrscheinlichkeit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Numerical measure ranging from 0 to 1 indicating the likelihood of an event occurring.

extracted_concepts.name: Terme
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Mathematical phrases composed of constants, variables, and arithmetic operators.

extracted_concepts.name: Gleichungen
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Mathematical statements asserting that two expressions are equal in value.

extracted_concepts.name: Ganze Zahlen
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Set containing all natural numbers, their additive inverses, and zero.

extracted_concepts.name: Rationale Zahlen
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Numbers that can be expressed as a quotient of two integers where the denominator is non-zero.

extracted_concepts.name: Lineare Funktionen
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Functions whose graphs form straight lines, typically defined by the equation y = mx + b.

extracted_concepts.name: Proportionale Zuordnungen
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Functional relationships where one variable is a constant scalar multiple of another.

extracted_concepts.name: Pythagoreischer Lehrsatz
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Geometric theorem stating that the square of the hypotenuse equals the sum of squares of the legs in a right triangle.

extracted_concepts.name: Ähnliche Dreiecke
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Triangles sharing identical corresponding angles and having proportional corresponding side lengths.

extracted_concepts.name: Baumdiagramme
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Graphical structures mapping sequential outcomes and their associated probabilities.

extracted_concepts.name: Bedingte Wahrscheinlichkeit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Probability of an event occurring given that another specific event has already occurred.

extracted_concepts.name: Zinsrechnung
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Financial mathematics calculating interest accrued on principal amounts over specified periods.

extracted_concepts.name: Maßstab
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Ratio defining the proportional relationship between dimensions on a representation and actual physical dimensions.

extracted_concepts.name: Variablen
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Symbolic placeholders representing unknown or varying numerical quantities in mathematical contexts.

extracted_concepts.name: Klammern und Ausklammern
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Algebraic techniques for grouping terms and extracting common factors from expressions.

extracted_relations.evidence: Curriculum extends counting numbers to include negative counterparts.
Rational number set expands integers to include fractional quotients.
Fractional notation serves as the primary representation for rational values.
Terminating and repeating decimal expansions correspond to rational numbers.
Algebraic terms are constructed by applying basic arithmetic operations.
Equations are formed by setting two independent terms equal to each other.
Linear functions extend single-variable equations into coordinate-based mappings.
Proportional relationships are linear functions constrained to pass through the origin.
Interest computations fundamentally depend on percentage calculation methods.
Conditional probability extends elementary probability theory to dependent event sequences.
Tree diagrams are standard tools for visualizing sequential conditional outcomes.
Term manipulation and simplification rely on bracket rules and factoring techniques.
Terms require variable symbols to denote unknown or changing magnitudes.
Geometric proofs involving similar triangles frequently utilize the Pythagorean relationship.
Similar triangles constitute a specialized classification within plane geometry.
Cartographic scales convert real-world length measurements to scaled diagram units.
Statistical bar charts are commonly paired with mean calculations for data interpretation.
Symmetry analysis is a core investigative property applied to plane geometric shapes.
Computing volumes and surface areas of three-dimensional solids depends on precise length measurements.
Unit conversion exercises routinely compare mass and capacity measurement systems.
